name: GSC Query Data Weekly Fetch
prompt:
Fetch GSC query and page data for www.bookconv.com using the service account credentials at scripts/gsc-service-account.json. Run:

```bash
cd "E:/一人公司/电子书格式转换站/ebook-converter"
node scripts/fetch-gsc-webmaster.mjs --days 30 --dimension query
node scripts/fetch-gsc-webmaster.mjs --days 30 --dimension page
```

Then summarize:
1. Total queries and impressions in the 30-day window
2. Top 10 queries by impressions
3. Top 10 pages by impressions
4. Any significant changes vs previous week (compare with 数据分析/GSC_API_query_*.json)

Output summary to console.
